reviews.title: Pretty good app!
reviews.text: I think this app is pretty good! It is totally free and no ads and it is kinda fun too and it is rated 4+ and I think this app is pretty good for little kids too and I am 11

reviews.title: You PAID for this free app.
reviews.text: The open screen prompted you to enable “web indexing” for the ad-free version. Your phone would act as an intermediary between the app and its partners, using your IP address to download and access “free data” from the web. What a free app.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Very nice and easy to use plus it was actually free which I love soooo much

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text: This app has helped me grown my normal life in my everyday routine. I love this app everyone you download it.

reviews.title: I like it
reviews.text: I’ve been needing a habit tracker for years. I finally got this app and so far I like it. I wish there was a way to back date some of the habits but starting somewhere is better than not starting at all!

reviews.title: Dark Mode + tiny bug
reviews.text: please Please PLEASE make a dark version!!! A night mode !! I have used this app for about a month and love the simplicity. I sit down every night and go through my habits. It’s truly wonderful — and the only thing I would want is a dark mode so my eyes don’t hurt. Also, there’s a small bug on the last day of each month where I’m unable to track my habits directly on the day. I don’t remember specifics, but I believe it opens the wrong day. I usually just go to the calendar and manually input my habits there. Thanks for your time!

reviews.title: Easy and no ads
reviews.text: I love that there are no overbearing ads. It’s simple and easy to use. It does exactly what it needs to without extra bells and whistles.

reviews.title: Great App. Ideas for Improvement
reviews.text: I like this app a lot because it is ad and subscription free. I do wish I could customize the habits a bit further by either leaving notes or setting custom intervals for each habit (x times daily, weekly, monthly, etc). I’d also like to be able to customize the view to track overall habit progress. A grid view option for monthly and yearly would be nice in addition to the current progress graph in statistics.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Wonderful free option for helping create habits. Only thing that I think would make it better would be to have a wigget on my phones Home Screen to help me remember throughout the day what my goals are.

reviews.title: No Purchases, No BS
reviews.text: Genuinely surprised to find an app nowadays without something behind a paywall. Might be simple, but thats whats great about it. Also takes up a fraction of the space the other trackers do. All around amazing app!

reviews.title: Good-ish App
reviews.text: I liked the app because it was free, however it would only let me add one habit. It works really well and I’d definitely recommend it if you want to focus on one habit. I’m not sure if it was my phone glitching or not, but I don’t think this app is for me.

reviews.title: Well detailed and functional
reviews.text: I love how clear and concise this app is. It helps me feel organized and fresh, and I love how it gives me reminders. It’s a great app

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: I’ve just downloaded it and already love it, simple and easy to use

reviews.title: Trading info for usage
reviews.text: Didn’t get past the opening screen of being asked to enable “web indexing” to get the ad-less version. Basically your phone acts as the middleman for the apps partners to use your IP address to silently download and access “free data“ found on the web. No thanks.

reviews.title: Charles oliveira
reviews.text: This is good because it sends notifications and reminds you to do whatever you need to do for FREE.

reviews.title: Great and simple
reviews.text: This app does everything I want for basic daily accountability. Very clean display and easy to manage habits. Only recommendation I have is for notifications: if I have already marked something as done it shouldn’t notify me later to complete it

reviews.title: Best Habit Tracker App
reviews.text: Genuinely the greatest habit tracker app I’ve installed, without unnecessary ads or subscriptions. It’s truly amazing how easy it is to use and the customization and reminders are great too. Definitely worth it.

reviews.title: If Only ….
reviews.text: This could be my perfect habit tracker if I could only reorder the list of tasks. How could something so simple be overlooked? Without it the app is virtually useless.
